I still cannot access the owner credential in the deployment runtime—the worker request returned **401: missing bearer token**. No deployment was submitted.

Important: the token was pasted into chat, so **rotate/revoke it now** in your IVX auth system. Then add the replacement through the secure environment-variable form as `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` (server-only), not in chat.

Current verified production remains live at commit `934e7e5e`; the new chat audit patch is not deployed.
